info.name: Retrieve a list of assignments for an organization (Early Access)

params.name: org_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Return the page of results immediately after this cursor

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Return the page of results immediately before this cursor

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page

items.docs:
Allows an admin to obtain a comprehensive list of all assignments within their organization.

#### Required permissions

- `View Organization assignments (org.learn_assignment.read)`

items.docs:

items.docs:

#### Required permissions

info.name: Bulk deletion of assignments in an organization (Early Access)

params.name: org_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

items.docs:
Allows an admin to delete multiple assignments within their organization.

**Note**: Assignments that are part of a Learning Program cannot be deleted through this endpoint.

#### Required permissions

- `Delete assignments (org.learn_assignment.delete)`
